analyst_view.overall: Early view: Rennes and Monaco are level on 16 points in 8th and 7th. Franck Haise's Rennes score plenty (21) but concede as many, including 13 goals in their last three away league games, while Monaco have not won in five league games (last 5 DLDLD). Both play in Europe on the Thursday before: Rennes at home to Dinamo Zagreb in the Europa League and Monaco away at Brighton in the Conference League, so both arrive on short rest.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Rennes' games have been wild (42 goals in ten), but Monaco's have been tight (24 in ten), and Thursday games for both may slow things down. That points to the number rather than past it.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Rennes at home should press, but nothing points clearly away from the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. Tired legs after Thursday games can mean late challenges, but nothing in the news points clearly either way.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.4 shots. Rennes shoot a lot at home and Monaco need a win, but fatigue after European games may trim the total a little; I stay near the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. Nothing points away from the number at this stage.
